[[Ort Hoogra-D'En]] maintained a '''base''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Pallaxides]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He used the location as a base of operations to harvest [[tamack]] to build [[spore bomb]]s to conduct a campaign of [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorism]] against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The base was protected by [[fahla]], a [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]]-dampening water plant that allowed Hoogra-D'en to hide the base's [[Power generator/Legends|power generator]] and [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. The based was [[Attack on Ort Hoogra-D'En's base|attacked]] by the Empire in retaliation for the [[Bombing of Syndaar Military Prep School|bombing]] of the [[Syndaar Military Prep School]].<ref name="GTG" />
